title: Kibbeh Nayyeh
description: A traditional dish from Lebanon, centered on bulgur, ground lamb, yellow onion, mint. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step. Cooked kibbeh inspired by kibbeh nayyeh. The traditional dish is served raw, but this variant is cooked to reduce the risks of raw minced meat.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 15 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Divide and shape the dough as required. Place on a lined tray and proof for about 12 minutes while the oven heats.
Instead of serving raw kibbeh nayyeh, bake the shaped meat-and-bulgur mixture at 190°C until ground meat reaches 71°C.
